title: Personal Protective Equipment, Part 2: Safety Footwear

regulatory_compliance.qco_order: Footwear made from Leather and other materials (Quality Control) Order, 2024

clause_1_scope: Amendment to IS 15298 (PART 2) (Personal Protective Equipment, Part 2: Safety Footwear): AMENDMENT NO. 2 DECEMBER 2019 TO IS 15298 (PART 2) : 2016 PERSONAL PROTECTIVE EQUIPMENT PART 2 SAFETY FOOTWEAR (Second Revision) (Amendment No. 1, National Annex B, clause B-1.1) — Substitute ‘Each pair of boot shall be supplied with the following information in English and any other language:’ for the existing. [Amendment No. 1, National Annex B, clause B-1.1, SI. No. (e)] — Delete. [Amendment No. 1, National Annex B, clause B-2.1, SI. No. (d)] — Delete. (CHD 19) Publication Unit, BIS, New Delhi, India
clause_3_terminology: Personal Protective Equipment, Part 2: Safety Footwear

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
